title: GHO CrowdFunding
tagline: A platform that rebuilds unbuilt projects with multiple developers and receives funding with GHO tokens on various chains using CCIP.
description:
Our platform allows you to register projects that are no longer being updated, or projects that you would like ongoing updates for, and full access to the introduction and code. Users can participate in these projects, collaborating on updates or rebuilds and raising funds to share profits with the original project owners and those involved in the revamped project.

To build trust between individual users, we provide user authentication using Polygon ID. When participating in project funding, individuals receive tokens as rewards for that specific project and gain membership in the DAO governance system. Participants in this DAO can provide input, vote on project direction, and participate in various social communities.

Additionally, reward token distribution and fund management for DAOs and fundraising leverage CCIP, allowing users to conveniently invest in multiple network chains rather than being limited to a limited network. This allows users to invest using GHO tokens on various networks according to their preferences. In addition, AA is used to provide gas payment to provide convenience to users.
how_its_made:
- Utilizing CCIP for the development of funding functionality across multiple chains.
- Integration of investor PolygonID for DAO (currently implemented for fund allocation only).
- Integration of PolygonID for secure project verification.
- Development of Contracts for managing core project metadata.
- Providing user convenience through gas payment using AA
